pairs.title: Stipendium operational rules date shift
pairs.old_text: Stipendium Hungaricum Operational Regulations (previous pack). Scholars follow the older published OR text and withdrawn call annexes where still linked on archived pages.
pairs.new_text: Stipendium Hungaricum Operational Regulations effective 31 August 2026. Scholars and hosts must use this OR text; older withdrawn packs should not be cited for current obligations.
expected_changes: Older OR packs are treated as withdrawn for current duties
Hosts and scholars should cite the new OR PDF

pairs.title: Study-permit extension filing emphasis
pairs.old_text: Students were sometimes told in informal guides to inquire at a counter first. Document lists varied by office handouts.
pairs.new_text: Extension must be submitted on Enter Hungary at least 30 days before expiry. Upload the required documents online, then give biometrics at the regional client service within 15 days.
expected_changes: Enter Hungary online filing is mandatory in the current know-how
Biometrics within 15 days after submission is stated
